SWE-bench Verified.name: SWE-bench Verified
SWE-bench Verified.description: A human-validated subset of 500 real-world GitHub issues. Evaluates an LLM agent's capability to resolve actual software bugs and pull requests in complex open-source codebases.

SWE-bench Pro.name: SWE-bench Pro
SWE-bench Pro.description: An advanced, long-horizon evaluation of software engineering agents tackling intricate, multi-file enterprise repository challenges with complex test harness verification.

Terminal-Bench 2.1.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
Terminal-Bench 2.1.description: Evaluates an AI agent's ability to operate in real bash/terminal command line environments, execute scripts, troubleshoot systems, and interact with tooling autonomously.

AIME 2026.name: AIME 2026
AIME 2026.description: American Invitational Mathematics Examination (2026 edition). Tests deep multi-step mathematical Olympiad reasoning and analytical problem-solving with integer answers.

GPQA Diamond.name: GPQA Diamond
GPQA Diamond.description: Google-Proof Q&A Diamond subset: extremely challenging PhD-level questions in physics, chemistry, and biology designed specifically to be resistant to web search shortcutting.

Humanity's Last Exam (HLE).name: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)
Humanity's Last Exam (HLE).description: Cross-disciplinary benchmark spanning mathematics, humanities, and sciences designed to test the boundaries of frontier AI reasoning at the limits of human knowledge.

OSWorld-Verified.name: OSWorld-Verified
OSWorld-Verified.description: Multimodal benchmark assessing an agent's capability to operate a real operating system desktop VM (GUI clicks, window management, keyboard, and cross-application workflows).
